classification.difficultyReason: Apply the sine rule, select the angle consistent with the obtuse given, then use the triangle angle sum and round to minutes.

content.prompt: Find the obtuse angle $\theta$ in this diagram, correct to the nearest minute.

spec.description: Upper-left, lower-left and right vertices; side 12 opposite the right angle label, side 15 opposite the upper-left vertex. Theta is at the obtuse lower-left vertex. Ordinary source blue outlines are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: The side opposite 35 degrees 24 minutes is 12; the side opposite the upper-left angle is 15. Theta is obtuse. No length units are supplied.

answer.worked:
Let $\alpha$ be the angle at the upper-left vertex.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\sin\alpha}{15}&=\frac{\sin35^\circ24'}{12}\\\sin\alpha&=\frac{15\sin35^\circ24'}{12}\\\alpha&=46.394151\ldots^\circ\end{align*}$$
The supplementary possibility, $133.605848\ldots^\circ$, would leave an acute $\theta$, so it is excluded because $\theta$ is obtuse.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ-35^\circ24'-46.394151\ldots^\circ\\\theta&=98.205848\ldots^\circ\\\theta&\approx98^\circ12'\end{align*}$$
